M2 withdraws the pending cancellation task itself. It must revoke the unexecuted Draft and cancel the old semantic Goal; it must not cancel the order.
M3 starts a new read-only logistics task. The pronoun keeps the mouse order as the domain target, but the revoked cancellation Draft and its transaction authority must not be resumed or inherited.

invariants: M1 targets exactly order 10003 / 无线鼠标 and may create only an authorization-gated cancellation Draft.
M2 means stop the pending cancellation task, not execute cancellation and not replace it with a generic order query.
After M2 the original cancellation Goal is CANCELLED and its Draft is REVOKED.
M3 is a new read-only logistics Goal for the same mouse order and must not reactivate, duplicate, authorize or commit the old cancellation task.
No business execute_command is authorized by any of these three utterances.
